newsitem.title: UK: Invesco in merger talks with AIM Management.
newsitem.headline: Invesco in merger talks with AIM Management.

text.p: Invesco Plc and AIM Management Group, a U.S. mutual fund company, confirmed on Thursday they were in talks about a possible merger, but no definitive agreement had been reached.
Fund manager Invesco and AIM said they were making the statement in response to press reports.
The Wall Street Journal reported on Thurday that Invesco was in talks to buy AIM for up to $1.8 billion.

AIM, a private company, ranks as the 13th largest mutual fund management company in the U.S, with assets under management of $54 billion. AIM had fund sales of more than $15 billion in the 12 months to June 30 1996.
Invesco, one of the largest global investment management groups, has more than $90 billion of assets under management.
